name: For Great Honor
label: Quest
description: For Great Honor: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Serving the Horde in one of the great battles against the Alliance is a source of great honor! The few however, that have served the Horde in ALL of our active battlefronts are our truly great fighters. We shall vanquish our opponents, not by fighting isolated skirmishes, but by waging a well-coordinated war.
Go forth and crush the Alliance in Arathi Basin, Alterac Valley and Warsong Gulch! For Honor! For the Horde!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Arathi is still wet with the blood of great warriors and the clash of steel still rings throughout Alterac. Do not waste my time unless you bring news from the front!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your trials have not been easy, but your courage did not escape you and your strength did not fail. Part with past tokens of victory, adventurer. None shall need them as a reminder of your worth. Stand up straight, friend. Today you will walk with great pride for you are a hero!
